method: Browser session (AWS WAF blocks plain HTTP). The families table's tbody rows were read with document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr'); each row's cells mapped with td.textContent.trim(). Column map used by the reader/tests: td[2]=Name, td[5]=Diet, td[6]=Type. td[0]=beta changelog marker, td[1]=icon, td[3]=Level (empty for families), td[4]=Abilities (empty), td[7]=Pop.
rows: Meat, Fish, Cheese, Bread, Fungus, Fruit
Meat, Fish, Cheese, Bread, Fungus, Fruit

conflicts.type_system: KB answers (2026-10-14, three sessions including fresh 9f2a4341) claimed the Ferocity/Tenacity/Cunning system does not exist in 1.60.1; this DB table has a Type column with exactly those values. The DB wins; the KB reading is recorded in docs/kb-sources/pets.md.
conflicts.owl_rename: The classic Owl family appears here as 'Bird of Prey' with an 'Updated Renamed' beta changelog marker; three KB sessions (incl. fresh 9a7c9a9c) read the client family name as 'Owl'. The DB plus its beta changelog marker win; the disagreement is unresolved by consensus and resolved by evidence.
conflicts.kb_diet_deltas: The KB's diets differ from this table for Crab (KB lacks Fruit), Turtle (this table adds 'Raw Fish') and Wind Serpent (order differs). The shipped data uses this table; diets are compared as sets because source order is not meaningful.

spell_checks.name: Feed Pet
spell_checks.tooltip: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.
spell_checks.note: Two independent checks disagree on whether the client states a duration: the rendered Wowhead spell-page tooltip (browser, 2026-10-14) shows none, while the fresh KB session 9f2a4341 says 'the client tooltip and buff icon state a duration of 15 seconds' (the original video source also said 15 s; a plan reviewer recalled ~20 s). The UI therefore claims no duration; this record is the cross-check trail.
